node.title: Re^3: PerlCon 2019 in Riga live streams
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: I would definitely encourage every Perl programmer to come to a Perl Conference! :-) Next year, YAPC::EU will be in Amsterdam in August. As I wrote in [id://1197332], it really was a lot of fun, and one of the things I like about Perl conferences is that they really are open to everyone. (And I'm sure people would be interested in your work on the RPi!)
